description: Headline counts for the published register: totals, areas, grades, forecast outcomes. A hit rate is only included once at least 30 forecasts have closed, as on the public site. Only forecasts whose criterion was fixed before the outcome count; back-captured entries with criterion_timing retrospective are reported separately as retrospective_accuracy, never as a hit rate. Signetex grades evidence and issues no true/false verdicts.
name: register_stats
